subject: Button Combinations
author: ZombieTron
body: In order to do lots of things, you have to press 2 buttons at the same time, and you can't hit the Zombies until a BIG B flashes on the screen. It probably isn't that different from other Res Evil games, but I haven't played them for a really long time.  I kinda want to just be able to attack without worrying about running out of bullets! I don't think Res Evil is for me... I loved the original game tho! 🙂

subject: Resident Evil
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
It looks good.... Controls are okay... But I was disappointed that you cant walk and shoot at the same time.. rather it was you stand at a spot, shoot, run to another spot, stand, shoot... Maybe they will change that when the game comes out... after all it is the demo...

The graphics are great... Definitely a buy for me... Not as spooky or as frightening as the first RE when you where in the mansion tho... But who knows, it seems they made it more into an Action/ Toned Down Horror Game....

My Opinion of the best Survival Horror game: Goes to Dead Space... BTW L4D, RE5, SH, or DS... definitely DS!!
